title: Whereabouts Of D.A. Fowler

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 25,000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch S.B. REC.
No. D 3708.
Date June 7, 1932.
Date 7 / 6 / 32.

Subject (in full) Whereabouts of D.A.Fowler.

Made by D.P.S.Pitts. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the endorsement made by the Officer
i/c Special Branch in connection with the whereabouts of
Donald Alexander Fowler, an Assistant Architect of the Pub-
lic Works Department, who is reported to have been missing
since May 31, 1932, I have to state that he is at present
residing at the following address:-
c/o Mr. D. Pratt,
Flat 2,
Western Apartments,
25 Avenue Petain.
Mr. Pratt can be located during office-hours at the
offices of the Shanghai Power Company, Nanking Road.
Fowler, on March 1, 1932, married a Russian - Ariadna
Morissoff - at the British Consulate. Mrs. Fowler may be
found at 64 Sun Avenue, Buboling Well Road.
It is stated that since his marriage, Fowler has been
getting very deeply into debt. He owes some $2500 to the
Auto-Palace for his motor car, which was seized on June 6
by representatives of the Auto-Palace, whilst he owes Messrs.
Credit Foncier d'Extreme Orient four months' rent for his
former apartment at 1230 Avenue Joffre. Several Hotels,
Clubs and Restaurants in Shanghai also have debit accounts
standing against Fowler's name.
It would appear that he is spending most of his time
at either the Western Apartments or 64 Sun Avenue in an
effort to avoid his creditors.

[Signature]
D. P. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

+2
[Signature]
9/6 [Signature]
Commissioner of Police,
Sir, Information.
[Signature] 9/6/32
[Signature] O. i/c Sp. Br.
JUNE 7 1932

表格第2号
G. 25,000-1-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案编号。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处 S.B. 登记簿
编号 D 3708。
日期 1932年6月7日。
日期 32年6月7日。

事由（全称） D.A. Fowler 的下落。

制作人 D.P.S. Pitts。转呈人 [签名]

关于特别处主管就工务局助理建筑师唐纳德·亚历山大·福勒（Donald Alexander Fowler）下落一事所作的批注，据悉该员自1932年5月31日起失踪，兹陈述如下：他目前居住于下列地址：
由 D. Pratt 先生转交，
2号公寓，
西恩公寓（Western Apartments），
贝当路（Avenue Petain）25号。
Pratt 先生可在办公时间内于南京路的上海电力公司办公室找到。
福勒于1932年3月1日在英国领事馆与一名俄国人——阿里阿德娜·莫里索夫（Ariadna Morissoff）结婚。福勒夫人可在卜罗林井路（Buboling Well Road）孙山路（Sun Avenue）64号找到。
据称，福勒自结婚以来债台高筑。他欠 Auto-Palace 汽车行约2500美元购车款，其汽车已于6月6日被 Auto-Palace 的代表扣押；此外，他还欠东方汇理银行（Credit Foncier d'Extreme Orient）四个月租金，系其此前居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）1230号公寓时所欠。上海多家旅馆、俱乐部和餐厅也有以福勒名义挂账的欠款。
看来他为了躲避债权人，大部分时间都待在西恩公寓或孙山路64号。

[签名]
D. P. S.
特别处主管。

+2
[签名]
9/6 [签名]
警务总监，
钧座，谨供参考。
[签名] 32年6月9日
[签名] 特别处主管
1932年6月7日

page_data.en:
C.R.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3908.
Date 3-6-32

Mr. Rendall P.W.D. reports that an
Assistant Architect named O.A. Zimler has
been missing since May 31 when he visited
the office in the morning.
His services have been unsatisfactory
and his services have been terminated
as from June 15.
He is married and is known to
be heavily in debt.
His address is: Flat A1,
1230, Avenue Joffre ( Lincoln Apartments )
Private enquiries requested.
no publicity.

3/6. S.H.
P.A.
S2. For discreet inquiry
in co-operation with the
French Police and report
please.
W.S. 4/6/32

S.P.S. Pitts
4/6pm.

C.R.
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别处登记室
编号 D 3908。
日期 32年6月3日

工务局的 Rendall 先生报告称，一名名为 O.A. Zimler 的助理建筑师自5月31日上午到办公室后一直失踪。
其工作表现令人不满，其聘用关系已自6月15日起终止。
该员已婚，众所周知负债累累。
其地址为：A1室，
霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）1230号（林肯公寓 Lincoln Apartments）
请求进行私下查访。
不得公开。

3/6. S.H.
P.A.
S2. 请与法国警察合作进行秘密调查，并具报为盼。
W.S. 32年6月4日

S.P.S. Pitts
4/6下午。
